task: How can judges test a submitted application in each supported browser environment? Include the minimum Chrome version and required flag, whether judges must open the live application, and where an entrant must provide private login credentials.
answer: The challenge homepage says the deployed app can be tested in ChatGPT’s in-app browser, where WebMCP works out of the box. For Google Chrome, the linked Chrome documentation says WebMCP starts with Chrome 149; enable chrome://flags/#enable-webmcp-testing, set the flag to Enabled, and restart Chrome. Judges must open the live application because the documentation says a browser or client must visit the site directly to discover callable tools and WebMCP requires an open browser tab or WebView. The fetched public pages do not reveal where private login credentials must be supplied, so that part is unsupported by this baseline arm.
